DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族の写真をお撮りしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like me to take a photo of your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。一人来られなかったので、その人の写真を後で合成して全員の記念にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 欠席家族の写真を後で合成し記念にしたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. One person couldn't come, so I'd like to add their photo later to make a keepsake of everyone together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to add the absent family member's photo later to make a keepsake.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いまこの場では、いらっしゃる方の写真を撮るご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So, for now, you'd like a photo of the people who are here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。いない人を待っているわけではありません。今日ここにいる四人で撮ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日在場の四人だけを撮り欠席者待ちではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. We aren't waiting for anyone who isn't here. Please photograph the four of us who are here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that only the four people present today should be photographed and you are not waiting for the absent person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 皆様の並び方が決まりましたら、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please let me know when everyone has decided where to stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四人が決まりました。この花壇も後ろに入ればうれしいですが、人の顔が分かる方を優先したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四人配置を決め花壇より顔が分かる構図を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The four of us are in position. It would be nice to include this flower bed behind us, but making our faces clear matters more.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the four people are positioned and you prefer clearly visible faces over including the flower bed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この位置からなら、四人と後ろの花壇が写ります。一枚撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: From here, I can include all four of you and the flower bed behind you. I'll take one now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。撮った元の写真も残します。合成した物だけにすると、誰が今日来たか混ざりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元写真も保管し編集物だけで来園者を混同しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll keep the original photo too. If I only keep the edited version, it could become confusing who actually came today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the original photo too so the edited version alone does not confuse who visited the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮れました。ご自身の端末で写りをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There we go. Please check how it looks on your own device.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四人が写っています。合成した記念の絵は別に作り、全員が今日公園へ来た証拠の写真とは言わず、家族にも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四人在場を確認し合成記念作品を全員来園の証拠としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: All four of us are in it. I'll make the edited family keepsake separately and explain to my family that it isn't photographic evidence that everyone came to the park today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have confirmed the four people present and will not treat the edited keepsake as evidence that everyone visited the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よい記念になりますね。それでは、ご家族で公園をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That will be a lovely keepsake. Enjoy the park with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 放送の「通過」という言葉をお確かめになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check what 'passing through' means in the announcement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。列車が来るということなので、扉の開く位置へ近づこうと思いました。乗れる列車の案内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通過放送を乗車のための列車到着と思い扉位置へ寄ろうとしたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Since it meant a train was coming, I thought I'd move closer to where the doors open. Is it announcing a train we can board?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you took the passing-train announcement to mean a train was arriving for boarding and were about to approach the door position.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この放送の「通過」は、停まらずに通るという案内です。乗車のための停車とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this announcement, 'passing through' means going through without stopping. It is different from stopping for passengers to board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乗るために近づく案内ではないのですね。来ることだけで、扉が開くと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通過は停まらず進む案内で扉が開く意味でないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it isn't telling us to move closer to board. I assumed the doors would open simply because a train was coming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand passing through means proceeding without stopping, not that the doors will open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 安全な位置でお待ちください。お乗りになる予定の列車はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait in a safe place. Do you know which train you intend to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 各駅停車を待っています。通過の列車を追って移動せず、自分の列車の停車案内を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 各駅停車待ちで通過列車を追わず停車案内を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm waiting for a local train. I'd like to check the stopping announcement for my train without moving along after the passing train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are waiting for a local train and want to check its stopping announcement without following the passing train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 停車の案内が出ましたら、表示もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When the stopping announcement is made, please check the display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 放送の言葉を聞いただけで全部同じ列車だと考えず、行先と停車の表示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 放送だけで同じ列車とせず行先と停車表示を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume they're all the same train just from hearing the announcement. I'll check the destination and stopping information on the display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will compare the destination and stopping display rather than assume it is the same train based only on the announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は、案内した線の内側でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: For now, please wait inside the line I indicated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらで待ちます。「通過」の意味が分かったので、列車が来ても乗車できると決めつけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定待機位置を守り列車到来と乗車可能を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait here. Now that I understand 'passing through,' I won't assume I can board just because a train is coming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will stay in the designated waiting position and distinguish a train's arrival from being able to board it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その位置でお待ちください。それでは、お気をつけて。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域のことばの交流会について、ご興味がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in the local language exchange gathering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あります。母語を紹介してほしいと聞きましたが、私は日本語を練習する参加者として行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母語紹介の依頼を聞いたが日本語練習参加が目的と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I heard they wanted me to introduce my native language, but I'd like to go as a participant practicing Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you heard the request to introduce your native language, but your purpose is to participate in Japanese practice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 運営する側ではなく、参加して話してみたいというご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you'd like to join in and try talking, rather than help run it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ずっと通訳する役や会を進める役を引き受けたつもりではありません。短く自分の話もしてみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通訳や進行役の引受けでなく自分の話を短くしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I didn't mean to take on interpreting throughout or leading the gathering. I'd like to briefly talk about myself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are not taking on interpreting or facilitating and would like to speak briefly about yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 参加目的は、交流会の担当へお伝えください。どのような練習をしたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the organizer why you want to participate. What would you like to practice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 仕事の話を日本語で練習したいと伝えます。母語の紹介もできる範囲でなら話しますが、全部を教える約束はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事説明を練習し母語紹介は可能範囲で全指導を約束しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll say I want to practice talking about my work in Japanese. I can introduce my native language as far as I'm able, but I won't promise to teach everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to practice explaining your work and can introduce your native language within your abilities without promising complete instruction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加の時間や進め方は、こちらの案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check this information for the meeting times and format.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時間を見ました。初めから最後まで運営を任されたと思わず、参加者の予定として確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内時間を参加者予定として確認し全時間運営担当とはしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked the times. I'll treat them as a participant's schedule, without assuming I've been put in charge from beginning to end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the listed times as a participant's schedule and not take them as responsibility for running the whole event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ相談するとき、いちばん希望する練習もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you speak with the organizer, also mention the practice you most want to do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 仕事で使う短い説明を練習したいです。先生役ではなく、話して聞く参加者として相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 仕事の短い説明を教師役でなく相互会話参加として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to practice short explanations I use at work. I'll ask as a participant who talks and listens, rather than as a teacher.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will discuss practicing short work explanations as a participant in mutual conversation, not as a teacher.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 参加目的を確認できました。それでは、交流会担当へお尋ねください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've clarified your purpose. Please ask the language exchange organizer. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察後の説明で、確認し直したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything from the explanation after your consultation that you'd like to check again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先生の言葉を全部書こうとしました。書いている間に次の話へ進み、後半を聞き取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 全文筆記に集中し診察説明後半を聞き逃したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I tried to write down everything the doctor said. While I was writing, they moved on, and I missed the latter part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you focused on writing everything down and missed the latter part of the medical explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認できた部分と、聞き逃した部分を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell the person in charge which parts you understood and which you missed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初の説明はメモにあります。最後の対応の話は途中までしか聞けず、全部分かったとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記録できた最初と未理解の最後の対応を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have notes on the first part. I only heard part of the final explanation about what to do, so I can't say I understood everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between the recorded first part and the final instructions you did not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 聞き直す方法を担当に確認します。メモの続きは書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person in charge how you can hear it again. Have you written anything after those notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 空いています。最初の話から想像して続きを書き足すのでなく、分からない所として残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録続きは空け想像で補完しなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I left it blank. Rather than imagine the rest from the first part and fill it in, I left it as something I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you left the rest blank and did not fill it in from imagination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 要点を確認したいというご希望もお伝えできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can also tell them you'd like to confirm the main points.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。次は一語ずつ追うより、まず説明を聞き、要点を確かめてからメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次は先に聞き要点確認後に記録する方法を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Next time, instead of chasing every word, I'd like to listen first, check the main points, and then take notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that next time you would like to listen first and take notes after confirming the main points.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を伝えますので、現在のメモをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that on, so please bring your current notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このメモを見せます。聞けた部分と空いている部分を示し、最後にどの対応を確認したいか自分でも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現メモの既知と空欄を示して本人が再確認箇所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show these notes. I'll point out what I heard and what's blank, and explain myself which final instructions I'd like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the known parts and blanks in your current notes and personally explain what needs checking again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 聞き直しのご希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on your request to hear the explanation again. Please wait here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされたカメラについて、分かることをお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you know about the camera you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 価格はこの広告と同じだと思います。似ている新品が載っているので、その額を買った時の金額として話そうとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た新品広告額を自分の購入額として報告しかけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think the price is the same as this advertisement. It shows a similar new camera, so I was about to report that as the amount paid when mine was bought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you were about to report the advertised price of a similar new camera as your own purchase price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で購入されたときの金額でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is that the amount you paid when you bought it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 贈り物なので購入額は知りません。広告の物が同じ型かも、まだ確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 贈物で購入額不明かつ広告と同型も未確認と明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was a gift, so I don't know the purchase price. I haven't even checked whether the advertised camera is the same model.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it was a gift, its purchase price is unknown, and you have not confirmed whether the advertisement shows the same model.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 知っている特徴と、参考に見た広告は分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please separate the features you know from the advertisement you looked at for reference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分のカメラの色と傷は覚えています。価格を先に決めるより、その特徴を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 覚えた色と傷を広告情報と分け特徴を優先して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I remember my camera's color and scratches. Rather than decide on a price first, I'd like to describe those features.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish the remembered color and scratches from the advertisement and prioritize describing the features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 型の情報や、以前の写真などはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have model information or any earlier photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家に箱があります。広告の型番を写して自分の型だとするのでなく、箱で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家の箱で型情報を確かめ広告型番を自分の物と転記しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the box at home. Rather than copy the advertised model number as mine, I'd like to check the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the model information on the box at home and will not copy the advertisement's model number as your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今分かる内容で相談し、不明な点は不明としてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Consult us using what you know now, and identify anything unknown as unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 贈られた物で購入額は不明と説明します。広告額を実際の支払額とせず、特徴と確認する予定の情報を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入額不明を明示し特徴と今後確認情報を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain that it was a gift and I don't know the purchase price. I won't treat the advertised price as the actual amount paid, and I'll distinguish the features from information I plan to verify.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the purchase price is unknown and distinguish the features from information you will check later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かる情報を整理していただき、ありがとうございました。それでは、担当へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for organizing the information you know. Please see the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このはがきに書いた内容の送り方についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about how to send what you've written on this postcard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人だけに読んでほしい相談を書きました。住所の面だけ見えるので、文章は隠れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人向け相談はがきの文章面が外から隠れると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote about something I only want my friend to read. I thought the writing would be hidden because only the address side would be visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the message side of a postcard about a private concern for your friend would be hidden from outside view.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はがきは文章の面も外側にあります。封筒に入れた手紙とは形が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The message side of a postcard is also on the outside. Its form differs from a letter inside an envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 裏返せば文章が見えますね。友人の名前を書けば、ほかの人に読めない状態になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文章面も見え氏名記載だけで閲覧不可になると思ったと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: You can see the message if you turn it over. I thought writing my friend's name would make it unreadable to other people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself in Japanese: the message side is visible too, and you had thought writing the recipient's name alone would prevent others from reading it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容を外側に出したくない場合は、別の形をお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you don't want the contents exposed on the outside, please consider a different format.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 封筒に入れる手紙に変えたいです。はがきのまま早く出すより、文章が外に出ない状態で準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当日差出しを急がず相談文を封筒形式へ変えたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to change it to a letter in an envelope. Rather than hurry to send it as a postcard, I'll prepare it so the writing isn't exposed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to put the private message in an envelope rather than rush to send it today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で中身と宛先を整えてから、発送方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you've prepared the contents and address yourself, please ask about sending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この相談文を便箋へ書きます。今のはがきは控えとして自分で保管し、外側に相談をまた書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 便箋に書き直し元はがきは自分で保管して外側に私事を書かない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll rewrite this message on letter paper. I'll keep the current postcard as my own copy and won't write my private concern on the outside again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will rewrite it on letter paper, keep the original postcard yourself, and not put private matters on the outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒の宛先も、現物でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the actual address on the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛先を確認して持ってきます。封筒なら友人以外が絶対に見ないとまで保証されたとは考えず、形を変えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先確認後に持参し封書でも絶対秘匿の保証とは扱わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the address and bring it in. I won't take this as a guarantee that absolutely nobody except my friend will see an envelope's contents; I'll change the format and ask about sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will bring it after checking the address and will not treat even a sealed letter as a guarantee of absolute privacy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 封書の準備ができましたらお持ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the letter when it's ready. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方が先に帰られるということですが、こちらのご相談はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your companion is leaving first; what would you like to do about your consultation here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に迎えを頼んでいましたが、急に帰ることになりました。私の相談は、自分で続けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎え家族が先帰りするが本人の相談は続けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd asked my family to pick me up, but they suddenly have to leave. I'd like to continue my consultation myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the family member picking you up is leaving early, but you want to continue your own consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認に使う資料は、ご本人がお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the documents needed for checking with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族のかばんに入れてもらっていました。帰る前に受け取り、自分で持っておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族かばんにある資料を帰る前に本人へ移したいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd put them in my family member's bag. I'd like to get them back before they leave and keep them with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to take the documents from your family member's bag before they leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料をお手元へ移してから、ご自身のご用件をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once the documents are with you, please explain your own business.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け取りました。家族が先に帰るからと、家族の名前で相談を引き取ってもらう予定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料を受け取り家族名義へ相談を引継ぐ予定はないと明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've received them. My family leaving first doesn't mean I plan to have the consultation taken over in their name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have received the documents and do not plan to transfer the consultation into your family member's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人が続けて相談されることで承ります。帰りの予定は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll proceed with you continuing the consultation yourself. Have you decided how you'll get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で帰る方法を調べます。迎えの変更だけで、急いで内容を読まずに決めるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路を調べ迎え変更を理由に未読で決定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look up how to get home myself. I won't rush into a decision without reading the contents just because my pickup plans changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check your route home and will not decide without reading because your pickup changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明後も、不明な点は確認していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can still ask about anything unclear after the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、自分の資料で説明を聞きます。迎えと手続きの相談を分け、時間が足りなければ確認して持ち帰ることも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人資料で説明を聞き時間不足なら持帰り相談も検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll listen with my own documents. I'll separate my pickup arrangements from the procedure, and if there isn't enough time, I'll ask about checking things and taking them home to consider.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will listen with your documents and, if time is short, consider asking to take them home after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望で担当へおつなぎします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll put you through to the person in charge with that request. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの大袋をお会計へお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be taking this large bag to the checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族の車で運ぶ予定でしたが、今連絡が来て、もう帰ったそうです。この量を自分だけで持てるか考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族車運搬が先帰りで変わり本人の運搬量を見直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I planned to carry it in my family's car, but they just contacted me to say they've already gone home. I'd like to think about whether I can carry this amount alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your plan to transport it by your family's car changed because they left early, and you want to reconsider how much you can carry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 帰る方法は、歩いてお帰りになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you planning to walk home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、歩きます。安いので選びましたが、車で載せるつもりの量をそのまま持つのは難しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 徒歩帰宅で車前提の大袋は持てそうにないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I'll walk. I chose it because it's cheap, but carrying the amount I'd intended to load into a car looks difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are walking home and probably cannot carry the large bag you chose assuming you had a car.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだお会計前ですので、量を見直すこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You haven't paid yet, so you can reconsider the amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は小さい物へ変えたいです。家族が戻ると勝手に決めて、車用の量で会計を進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会計前に小品へ変更し家族車の再来を勝手に期待しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to switch to something smaller today. I won't assume my family will come back and pay for an amount intended for a car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will switch to a smaller item before paying without assuming the family car will return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今お持ちのほかの荷物もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any other belongings with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事のかばんがあります。新しい買物だけでなく、帰る時に全部持つ分を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事かばんも含め帰宅時の総荷物を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my work bag. I'll consider everything I'll be carrying home, not just the new shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consider your total load on the way home, including your work bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの小さい物をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take a look at this smaller one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらにします。単価だけでなく持ち帰り方を見直し、大袋は今日は買わず、小さい方を自分で運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単価だけでなく帰宅方法で小品を選び大袋購入を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take this. I'll reconsider how to get it home as well as the unit price, skip the large bag today, and carry the smaller one myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose the smaller item based on the way home as well as unit price and stop buying the large bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 小さい方で承ります。それでは、お帰りの荷物にもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The smaller one it is. Take care with your bags on the way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 木陰をご覧になっていましたね。何か気になる所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the shade under the trees. Is something concerning you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 気になるというより、懐かしい感じがします。子供の頃、祖母と歩いた母国の公園を思い出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園景色で母国の祖母との幼い散歩を思い出したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's more that it feels nostalgic. It reminded me of the park in my home country where I walked with my grandmother as a child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the park scenery reminded you of childhood walks with your grandmother in your home country.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 初めての場所でも、昔のことがふと思い浮かぶことがありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sometimes old memories suddenly come to mind even in a place you've never been before.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここは初めてです。木が並んで日陰になっている様子が、昔の散歩に似ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 初来訪の公園の木陰が幼い日の散歩を思い出させたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's my first time here. The rows of trees and the shade they make are like those walks long ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the shade in a park you are visiting for the first time brought back childhood walks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 思い出と重なったのですね。今日はどのように過ごされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It brought back those memories. How would you like to spend today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木陰をゆっくり歩きたいです。祖母も急がずに歩く人で、私が見つけた物の話をよく聞いてくれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 木陰を静かに歩きたい希望と祖母が話を聞いてくれた思い出を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to walk slowly in the shade. My grandmother never hurried either, and she often listened to me talk about things I'd found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want a quiet walk in the shade and remember your grandmother listening to your stories.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの木陰の通路をお歩きいただけます。ご家族にも今日の景色をお話しになれそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can walk along this shaded path. Perhaps you can tell your family about today's scenery too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家族も祖母のことをよく覚えています。今日の景色を見て、こんな思い出が浮かんだと話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日の景色で浮かんだ祖母との思い出を家族にも話したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My family remembers my grandmother well too. I'd like to tell them that seeing this scenery brought back these memories.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would also like to tell your family about the memories of your grandmother brought back by today's scenery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 思い出を話すよいきっかけになりそうですね。どうぞ、ご自分のペースでお歩きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It sounds like a good opportunity to share memories. Please walk at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。少し歩いてから、家族に電話してみます。祖母が散歩の時によく話していたことも、一緒に思い出せそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 散歩後に家族へ電話して祖母の話を一緒に思い出したいと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. After walking a little, I'll call my family. We may also remember together the things my grandmother often talked about on our walks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have decided to call your family after the walk and recall your grandmother's stories together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よい散歩の時間になりますね。それでは、木陰の景色をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: It sounds like a lovely walk. Enjoy the scenery in the shade.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かご案内が必要でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内ではなく、少しお礼を伝えたくて来ました。父が昔、鉄道の仕事をしていて、今日ここで働く方を見て思い出したんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父の鉄道勤務の思い出から駅員へ感謝したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to say a little thank-you, rather than ask for directions. My father used to work on the railway, and seeing the people working here today reminded me of him.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that memories of your father's railway work made you want to thank the station staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そうでしたか。お父様も、この駅でお働きだったのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I see. Did your father work at this station too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅ではありません。母国の鉄道です。忙しい時間でも、お客様に挨拶することを大事にしていたと聞きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父は母国の鉄道で働き挨拶を大事にしていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not this station. It was the railway in my home country. I've heard he valued greeting passengers even during busy times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your father worked on the railway in your home country and valued greeting passengers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 遠くの鉄道のお話なのですね。今日はご旅行ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it was a railway far away. Are you traveling today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。朝、係の方に道を教えてもらって、落ち着いて旅を始められました。それを父にも話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝の道案内で落ち着けた旅の経験を父にも話したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. A staff member gave me directions this morning, and I was able to start my trip feeling calm. I'd like to tell my father about it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to tell your father how the morning directions helped you begin your trip calmly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それはよかったです。お父様にも、旅のよい思い出になりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's good to hear. It will be a happy memory of the trip for your father too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父の働いていた場所を調べてほしいわけではありません。今日助けてもらったことに、自分からお礼を言いたかったんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務歴の調査依頼ではなく本人のお礼と明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm not asking you to look up where my father worked. I wanted to thank you myself for the help I received today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clarify in Japanese that this is your personal thanks, not a request to investigate his employment history.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お気持ちをお伝えいただき、ありがとうございます。これから乗る列車はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you for sharing your feelings. Do you know which train you'll be taking next?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。行先も確認しました。短い話を聞いてくださってありがとうございます。これからホームへ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行先確認済みで話を聞いてもらった礼を述べ乗車へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've checked the destination too. Thank you for listening to my little story. I'll head to the platform now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have checked your destination, thank them for listening, and head toward your train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらこそ、うれしいお話でした。それでは、お父様へのお土産話とともに、よい旅を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you too; it was lovely to hear. Have a good trip and take that story home to your father.
